objectives.text: Create a Community Development Financial Institutions Fund to promote economic revitalization and community development through investment in and assistance to community development financial institutions, including enhancing their liquidity.

citations.quote: The purpose of this subchapter is to create a Community Development Financial Institutions Fund to promote economic revitalization and community development through investment in and assistance to community development financial institutions, including enhancing the liquidity of community development financial institutions.

objectives.text: Congressional findings recognizing that many urban, rural, and Native American communities face critical social and economic problems arising from lack of economic growth, poverty, and lack of employment and other opportunities.

citations.quote: many of the Nation's urban, rural, and Native American communities face critical social and economic problems arising in part from the lack of economic growth, people living in poverty, and the lack of employment and other opportunities;

objectives.text: Congressional finding that restoration of these communities requires coordinated development strategies, intensive supportive services, and increased access to equity investments and loans for development activities.

citations.quote: the restoration and maintenance of the economies of these communities will require coordinated development strategies, intensive supportive services, and increased access to equity investments and loans for development activities, including investment in businesses, housing, commercial real estate, human development, and other activities that promote the long-term economic and social viability of the community;

objectives.text: Congressional finding that community development financial institutions have proven their ability to identify and respond to community needs for equity investments, loans, and development services.

citations.quote: community development financial institutions have proven their ability to identify and respond to community needs for equity investments, loans, and development services.

notes: This section (12 U.S.C. 4701) contains only findings and purposes; it imposes no obligations (no actor/modality/action duties), so the obligations array is empty. The section establishes the CDFI Fund's stated statutory purpose, which falls within scope as core program authority for a federal commercial lending subsidy/assistance program. The terms 'Community Development Financial Institutions Fund' and 'community development financial institutions' are used but not defined within this section (definitions would appear elsewhere in the subchapter, outside this source item). Text stated to contain laws in effect on July 22, 2026.
